prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Dallas for braces or Invisalign?
engine_stated_criteria: A strong Dallas option to start with is Dr. Hessam Rahimi at Fusion Orthodontics
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—case complexity, location, budget, and how much you value convenience all matter. **A strong Dallas option to start with is Dr. Hessam Rahimi at Fusion Orthodontics**: he is listed as board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics and offers both braces and Invisalign. Fusion’s Dallas office is at **19200 Preston Rd., Suite 100**.

Other options worth comparing include **Walnut Central Orthodontics** and **Dallas Orthodontics**; both offer braces and Invisalign and have strong reported patient ratings. Ratings are only one signal, so I’d get **two or three consultations** before choosing.

At each visit, ask who will supervise your treatment, which option they recommend and why, what the full fee includes (including retainers and refinements), and how emergencies or missed appointments are handled. The best fit is the orthodontist who explains your options clearly and gives you a treatment plan you’re comfortable with.
